title: Branches and Loops
introduction: Branches choose behaviour from conditions, while loops repeat work in a controlled way.
learningOutcomes: Select behaviour with if, else if and else.
Choose an appropriate loop for repeated work.
Explain how a loop condition prevents or ends repetition.

activities.question: Order these branches from the first condition checked to the fallback branch.
activities.explanation: An if starts the chain, optional else-if branches test alternatives, and else handles anything remaining.

activities.question: Which loop is most direct when an action must run exactly three times?
options: A for loop with a counter
activities.explanation: A counter-based for loop clearly expresses initialisation, continuation and increment for a known repeat count.
